items.text: Muca olwoŋo jo Icrael te kobbigi ni, “Wun jo Icrael, winy wunu cik ducu kede gin ame ociko ducu ame akobo tin kun iwinyo wunu. Pwony wunu dok daŋ igwokere wunu me cobogi.
Rwot Obaŋawa rik ocikere kedwa i Koreb.
Rwot rik mom oketo cikere man kede kwariwa, ento ocikere kedwa, wan luŋ ame pwod tin otye kan kun okwo-ni.
Rwot rik okobo kedwu waŋ i waŋ i te kidi, i dye mac.
An rik onwoŋo acuŋ i akina Rwot kede wun i kare-naca, omio mom ite yito wunu malo i wi kidi.” En rik okobo ni,
“An a Rwot Obaŋani ame rik akwanyi oko i lobo me Miciri, i ot me opii.
“Kur dok ibed Obaŋa moro ocele kono an keken.
“Kur iti cal ginnoro ame ipao piri keni, kadi cal ginnoro ame tye malo i polo, onyo ame tye piny i wi lobo, onyo ame tye i pii ame tye piny i te lobo;
kur iryebere piny i nyimgi, kur iworgi; pien an a Rwot Obaŋani, an Obaŋa ame anyek; aketo can i kom ikwae a jo ame daga pi bal a kwarogi naka tuno i kom lwagi me adek kede me aŋwen i kom ikwaegi,
ento anyuto marra a mom lokere baŋ jo tutumia kede tutumia ame mara, ame mako cikka.
“Kur ilwoŋ nyiŋ Rwot Obaŋani nononono; pien Rwot bino miyo kop loo ŋat alwoŋo nyiŋe nononono.
“Po pi nino me cabit, ikwer bed acil, kite a rik Rwot Obaŋani ociki kede.
I tic tic atek pi nino abicel, kun itio ticci ityeko luŋ;

ento nino me abiro en cabit a Rwot Obaŋani. Nino-nono kur igud ticcoro, kadi yin ikomi, onyo wodi, onyo nyari, kadi opiini onyo aŋecani, onyo twonni onyo kanani, onyo dyaŋŋi moro, onyo arokkoro ame bedo i akinawu; wekopiini kede aŋecani owe daŋ bala yin.
Myeroipo ni yin daŋ yam ibedo opii i lobo Miciri, Rwot Obaŋani en a rik obin okwanyi oko i kuno ni igwok nino me cabit.
“Wor pappi kede totti, kite a Rwot Obaŋani ociki kede, me iperakino i lobo, dok ibed kun nyimi cil, i lobo ame Rwot Obaŋani bino miyi.
“Kur daŋ ikob kop goba i kom ŋattoro.
“Kur daŋ ibed paro dako a ŋattoro, kur ipar ot a ŋattoro kadi poto mere, onyo aŋeca mere, onyo twonnere, onyo kana mere, onyo kadi ginnoro ducu ame tye baŋe.

“Rwot rik oko bo magi luŋ baŋwu wun luŋ kun icokere wunu karacel i te kidi. En rik okobo i dwon aloŋo i dye mac, kede pol, kede pol oculle acula ekuna, mom dok te medo iye kopporo ocele. Rik en te coyo kop man luŋ i kom kiddi apada aryo, te miyogi baŋa.
“Kare ame rik iwinyo wunu dwon ame opelo i dye piny acol kun mac tye ka waŋ i kidi, otel me atekerewu kede odoŋewu te bino baŋa.

Gin rik te kobo ni, ‘Nen ba, Rwot Obaŋawa doŋ onyuttiwa kwogo mere kede dittere, dok daŋ otyeko winyo dwone i dye mac. Tin doŋ wan oŋeo ni Obaŋa twero kop kede dano, eka dano-nono pwod dok te medde bedo kwo.
Doŋ piŋo myero omiye me to oko aman, pien twon mac adwoŋ ca amito waŋowa oko? Ateni, abino to oko ka ce omedde winyo dwon Rwot Obaŋawu kun kobo kedwa tyen me aryo,
pien mom tye ŋattoro ame tye kede kom ame yam koŋ owinyo dwon Obaŋa akwo kun kobo i dye mac eka, pwod dok te medde bedo kwo, kite a wan owinyo kede.
Yin wot aceggi me iwiny kop luŋ ame Rwot Obaŋawa bino kobo; yin ite kobbiwa kop luŋ ame Rwot Obaŋawa bino kobbi; wan obino winyo ote daŋ tiyo’.
“Rwot rik te winyo kop ame wun ikobo wunu baŋa, Rwot te kobba ni, ‘Atyeko winyo kop ame lwak okobo baŋi. Kop ame gin okobo luŋ, gin okobo kakare.
Kono kom gin omedde bedo kede kodi cunnyono kare ducu, cuny me lwora kede me gwoko cikka luŋ, kono ber; i nyimgi kede me itinogi kono obedo acil nakanaka,
Wot ikobbigi ni, “Dok wunu doŋ i kemawu.”
Ento yin cuŋ i ŋeta kan, an abino titti cik luŋ kede icwil, karacel kede gin aciko luŋ, ame yin ibino pwonyogi kede, me gin wot cobgi i lobo ame amiyogi me bedo meggi’.
Pi mannono, gwokere wunu icobogi kite ame Rwot Obaŋawu ociko kede, kur igak wunu i ciŋwu tuŋ cem onyo tuŋ cam.
Lub wunu ka yo luŋ ame Rwot Obaŋawu ocikowu ni ilub wunu; me ibed wunu kwo, dok nyimwu daŋ bed acil, dok iperakino wunu i lobo ame ibino wunu gamo me bedo megwu.
